name: Mov
about: Mov is Gladias's friend in the Order of Steering, who shadows his meetings and tails suspects. The book does not describe his appearance, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: you're not just someone about to join me as a Sentinel, you're a friend
facts.fact: A Sentinel in the Order and Gladias's friend.

facts.quote: Mov then opened up his privacy robe, and took out a large package from an inside pocket.
facts.fact: Wears a privacy robe with inside pockets.

facts.quote: Mov, who was already wearing his privacy robe
facts.fact: Wears the privacy robe in public.

facts.quote: Mov removed the hood on his privacy robe, a gesture to appear less threatening.
facts.fact: Lowers his hood to seem less threatening.
Seila calls him Gladias's shadowy friend.

facts.quote: So I threw my surveillance bat into an innocuous spot

descriptor: a man in his early forties, short and stocky, deep umber skin, a shaved head and a neat salt-and-pepper goatee, a wry half-smile, wearing a dark olive sleeveless utility tabard covered in flat sealed pockets, cinched by a crossing chest harness, over a slate-grey seamless high-neck bodysuit, khaki segmented trousers, black soft-soled boots, a thin band around his throat and a tiny lens clipped at his collar
